blocks.body: MITHRIL & MORTAR NOTICE: Stoneweave is uncertified personal armor produced by an unlicensed syndicate. Its continued excellence is under review.

blocks.label: At The Table
blocks.body: Tier 1 armor. Base Score 3, Base Thresholds 6/13. Seamless: when you take minor damage, roll a d12; if the result is your level or lower, mark Stress instead.
